text:
rachel: Acme POC asked for a short IR & breach notify clause for the SOW. Need timelines, who we CC, and whether forensics are included. Can we make a compact blurb?

tom: Quick bullets: Hosted: notify designated customer contact within 72h of confirmed incident; initial triage and updates within that window; full report usually 7-30 days (POC target 7-14 days).

priya: Private/VPC/on-prem: we will notify within 72h of confirmation and provide remote assistance for evidence collection; customer owns infra-level forensics unless SOW states otherwise.

lee: Dedicated/reserved customers: prioritized triage (often 24-48h) and broader telemetry availability if included in the subscription or SOW.

rachel: Who to CC on initial notify?

tom: cc customer security lead + legal (if provided), AE, CS rep; internal cc: lee (legal), security on-call, and ir-bot to auto-create an incident.

priya: SIG/CAIQ & evidence: we can attach our completed SIG/CAIQ, SOC summary, and an artifact checklist (logs, timeline, config). Live forensic imaging or ad-hoc evidence collection during an IR is billable unless pre-authorized in the SOW.

lee: Legal note: do not promise regulator filings. Say "notify within 72h" but only commit to regulator submissions if contractually agreed.

rachel: Can someone paste a one-paragraph SOW blurb we can drop in?

tom: "Redwood will notify the customer's designated security contact within 72 hours of confirming a security incident affecting customer data or service availability. For Hosted customers, Redwood will perform initial triage and provide regular updates; a final incident report will generally be delivered within 7-30 days (POC engagements typically target 7-14 days). For Private/VPC/on-prem deployments, the customer retains responsibility for infrastructure-level forensic work; Redwood will assist with artifact collection and analysis upon request. For Dedicated Reserved Capacity customers, Redwood provides prioritized triage and expanded telemetry support. Any forensic services beyond initial triage are billable unless explicitly included in the SOW. Redwood will coordinate with customer security and legal contacts as specified in the order form."

priya: I'll attach SIG/CAIQ PDF and artifact checklist when sending.

ir-bot: Incident ticket created if needed: INC-2026-6007 https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-6007

rachel: Thanks, team :thumbsup:
